review.note: Drafted by the assistant in M44b under the owner's dated exception, from the sources named and not from a reading of them; the argument is the thing to check, not only the dates.

explanation: The protests of September 2022 were against the republic the revolution founded and against one of its founding acts in particular. Compulsory hijab was imposed in the first years after 1979 and the morality patrol that enforced it is an organ of that state; a woman died in its custody and the slogan that followed named the system, not the patrol. The claim is that the object of the protest is the order of 1979. It is not a claim that the revolution caused the protest, which needed forty years of its own.
